features.name: An agent turn in the transcript
features.what: A finished turn shows the prompt, the agent's steps as tool rows and the final answer.
features.reach: Open a session where the agent read, searched, edited files and ran a command.
features.proof: The prompt bubble, one row per tool call with its target and edit counts, and the answer's Markdown.

scenarios.title: Tool rows and the answer of an agent turn render
Clicking an Edit File row shows the edit as a diff

features.name: Markdown in answers
features.what: Answers render headings, numbered lists, tables and highlighted code in several languages.
features.reach: A session whose answer has headings, a list, a table and fenced code.
features.proof: Each construct is present as its own element with its text.

scenarios.title: Headings, a numbered list, a table and code blocks render

features.name: A streaming answer
features.what: While the agent answers, the text grows in place and the composer shows Stop. A reply taller than the screen stops the follow at its start and offers Scroll to bottom.
features.reach: Send a prompt to a model that streams for a few seconds, watch the open session.
features.proof: Stop shows during the stream; after it the reply's start is on screen, Scroll to bottom is offered and brings the reply's last sentence into view.

scenarios.title: A long streamed reply stops at its start and Scroll to bottom reaches its end

features.name: Scrolling a long chat
features.what: A long session opens at its end; scrolled up, an arrow brings the reader back to the end.
features.reach: Open a session with several turns, scroll up.
features.proof: The last answer is on screen after opening, Scroll to bottom appears after scrolling up and brings the end back.

scenarios.title: A long session opens at its end and Scroll to bottom returns there

features.name: Message actions
features.what: Under each message: copy its text; under a prompt: revert the session to before it.
features.reach: Hover a message and use the buttons under it.
features.proof: Copy puts the message text on the clipboard; Revert removes the prompt and its answer from the transcript and puts the prompt back in the composer.
